about.title: Strategy and execution, end to end.
paragraphs: I started freelancing for local businesses in Lahore in 2022, while I was still studying. Since then I have worked inside a software house, a fintech startup, a news brand and two medical aesthetics groups, and I have run client work alongside every full-time role.

My strongest work is lead generation on Meta. For a UK-standard aesthetics academy I brought in more than 7,600 doctor leads at about $1 each, which turned into 45 to 50 enrollments and over PKR 1 crore (about $35K) in revenue every month.
Today I lead marketing for a medical aesthetics clinic with four branches in Lahore and Karachi, managing the sales, creative and content teams.

caseStudies.title: Doctor Lead Generation
caseStudies.summary: Lead form campaigns that filled premium aesthetic training batches with PMDC-registered doctors.
caseStudies.challenge: Fill recurring aesthetic training batches with qualified MBBS doctors on a lean budget, in a niche where every lead has to be a registered medical professional.
whatIDid: Built and managed 30 campaigns, 50 ad sets and 135 ads on Meta.
Used ABO to test audiences (open, interest, narrow) and CBO to scale winners.
Ran Instant Form lead campaigns with qualifying questions for doctors.
Tested static offer posts against doctor testimonial videos and moved budget to the winners.
Supported ads with educational reels, testimonials and lives with a UK master trainer.
results: 7,600+ leads at ~$1.00 average CPL in about 6 months.
~1,750 leads in June 2026 alone on ~$1,830 spend.
PKR 1 crore+ (~$35K+) monthly revenue, 45 to 50 doctors enrolling every month.
Organic side effect: +2,000 Instagram followers in 2 months and +5,000 Facebook followers in 4 months.

caseStudies.title: Static vs Video: Creative Test
caseStudies.summary: A month-long test that proved simple static offers beat doctor testimonial videos on cost per lead.
caseStudies.challenge: The team assumed testimonial videos from doctors would convert best. The data needed to settle it before more budget went into video production.
whatIDid: Ran static offer posts and doctor testimonial videos side by side in the same campaigns.
Compared leads and CPL at ad level over the month.
Shifted spend to the static creatives once the gap was clear.
results: Top static posts delivered 280 leads at $0.60 and 319 leads at $0.93.
Testimonial videos got 1 to 5 leads each at $1.47 to $4.88 CPL.
Budget moved to statics, which kept blended CPL near $1 while volume grew.

caseStudies.title: Audience Testing at Scale
caseStudies.summary: A/B tested open, interest and narrow audiences; one ad set earned Meta's High Performing tag.
caseStudies.challenge: Find which audience definition could carry volume without CPL drifting up as budget scaled.
whatIDid: Split audiences into open targeting, new interest stacks and narrow lists.
Ran them as A/B ad sets with equal budgets, then consolidated winners.
Refreshed batch-specific ad sets for each course intake.
results: Best ad set: 1,448 leads at $1.06, tagged High Performing by Meta.
Open targeting delivered 725 leads at $1.30 as a reliable volume source.
Narrow audiences were the most expensive ($1.76) and were cut.

caseStudies.title: News Brand, Zero Ad Spend

caseStudies.challenge: Grow a new news brand across four platforms with no advertising budget at all.
whatIDid: Built a content calendar and daily posting schedule for each platform.
Designed daily posts and edited short videos for news moments.
Managed all four channels and adjusted formats to what each platform rewarded.
results: YouTube monetized: 2,000 subscribers and 4,000 watch hours.
Facebook page monetized: 10,000 organic followers, 5K to 10K daily views.

process.title: Audit
process.text: Check tracking, pixel, forms, account structure and past data before any budget goes live.

process.title: Plan
process.text: Define the audience, the offer and the funnel, and set the CPL and revenue targets.

process.title: Launch & test
process.text: Run audiences and creatives against each other in ABO, then scale winners in CBO.

process.title: Optimise
process.text: Kill what is expensive, move money to what converts, refresh creatives before fatigue.

process.title: Close the loop
process.text: Work with sales and the CRM so every lead is followed up and tied back to revenue.
